versionPolicy.reason: Maintainer requested only v2.6.0 for v2 and v1.9.4 for v1. Legacy URLs retain stable IDs as draft redirects.

classificationSource.usage: Product names, series and ten popular-board selections are reviewed editorial labels. Chip targets, variant identity and asset URLs are rechecked against each owning firmware tag; no Feishu binary link is copied. Popular does not assert a current measured download ranking.

excludedAssets.reason: CI-named build has no exact build entry in the v2.6.0 tag config.json files; not mapped to a near-match or offered as a normal-device download.
